de.title: Englische Redewendungen 1: piece of cake und mehr
de.intro: Vier gängige englische Redewendungen mit deutscher Bedeutung und Beispielsatz.

cards.back: etwas ganz Leichtes, ein Kinderspiel. Don't worry about the test, it will be a piece of cake.
das Eis brechen, eine verkrampfte Stimmung zwischen Fremden lösen. A short game helped to break the ice at the workshop.

cards.front: to hit the nail on the head
cards.back: den Nagel auf den Kopf treffen, genau richtig liegen. You hit the nail on the head when you said the plan was too risky.
sich nicht wohlfühlen, leicht angeschlagen sein. I'm feeling a bit under the weather, so I'll stay home today.

en.title: English Idioms 1: piece of cake and more
en.intro: Four common English idioms with their meaning and an example sentence.

cards.back: something very easy. Don't worry about the test, it will be a piece of cake.
to ease the awkwardness between people who don't know each other yet. A short game helped to break the ice at the workshop.

cards.front: to hit the nail on the head
cards.back: to identify something exactly, to be exactly right. You hit the nail on the head when you said the plan was too risky.
slightly ill or not feeling well. I'm feeling a bit under the weather, so I'll stay home today.
